toolId.description: Tool identifier. An exact visible ID is retained; an unversioned name resolves to the newest visible family version. The response echoes the resolved ID.

workspaceId.description: Workspace whose integration allowlist, credentials, and environment variables govern this call.

input.description: Arguments keyed by published parameter IDs. Hidden and undeclared fields are rejected. Send connected credentials as top-level `credentialId`, not `input.credential`, `input.credentialId`, or `input.oauthCredential`. Whole-value `{{VAR_NAME}}` references resolve environment variables only for `user-only` parameters; other values pass through unchanged.

additionalProperties.description: One argument value. Its shape is declared by the tool parameter.

credentialId.description: Connected credential to authenticate with. Required for tools declaring required OAuth or a required credential-selector parameter. Use List credentials to find candidates; do not send credential aliases inside `input`.

timeoutSeconds.description: Maximum wait time in seconds; defaults to 120 and cannot exceed 300. Timeout does not guarantee that a third-party side effect was cancelled.

toolId.description: Tool that ran. An unversioned name resolves to the newest version visible in the workspace, so this can differ from the id in the path.

status.description: Whether the tool reported success. A failed tool call is still a 200.

output.description: Whatever the tool produced, shaped by its declared outputs.

message.description: Why the tool call did not succeed.

id.description: Field identifier, and the key its value is stored under.

type.description: Editor control the field renders as, e.g. `short-input`.

required.description: Whether a value must always be supplied. A field required only under some configuration reports `false` and carries `requiredWhen`.

requiredWhen.description: Condition under which the field is required.

hidden.description: Whether the field is hidden in the editor.

reactiveCondition.description: Credential-kind requirement for this field or option; inspect the selected credential before using it.

condition.description: Condition under which the field applies at all.

any.description: At least one listed field must hold a value.
